author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that an integral curve on a Noetherian surface satisfying the resolution conditions becomes regular after a finite sequence of blowups of the surface in closed points (statement lines 4306-4315). The proof (proof lines 4316-4324) mirrors the resolution sequence of the curve on the surface and identifies the strict transform with the blowing up of the curve. H2: a complete constructive argument using the identification of strict transforms.
